key.name: source-folder
key.description: The folder scanned for this cycle's databases and plates archive. Empty means the XDG Downloads folder.

key.name: plates-archive
key.description: Full path to the last-selected plates zip archive. Cleared automatically if it is no longer readable at launch.

key.name: verify-copies
key.description: Read each database back from the drive and compare checksums after copying.

key.name: replace-old-databases
key.description: Delete previous-cycle aviation and obstacle databases from the drive root.

key.name: full-plate-rebuild
key.description: Write every plate in the archive instead of only the ones that are new or have changed. Much slower; useful if a drive is suspected of holding corrupt files.

key.name: eject-when-finished
key.description: Eject each drive automatically after it is updated successfully.

key.name: selected-drives
key.description: Entries of the form "{uuid}|{label}", matched by UUID first and label second on the next launch.

key.name: manual-targets
key.description: Folder-target paths added through Choose Folder…, persisted across launches.

key.name: first-run-done
key.description: Whether the one-time first-run banner has already been shown.

key.name: system-type
key.description: Whether the aircraft this app is preparing databases for is a certificated (STC'd) install or an experimental/LSA one. Never inferred — asked once on first run, changeable in Preferences.

key.name: data-provider
key.description: Which vendor's database and plates files this app should recognise. Never inferred — asked once on first run, changeable in Preferences. Only Dynon enables the automatic download checker.

key.name: download-folder
key.description: Where checked-for updates are downloaded. Empty means the XDG Downloads folder.

key.name: show-tray-icon
key.summary: Show an icon in the system tray
key.description: Publish a StatusNotifierItem so the application stays reachable after its window is closed. Desktops without a StatusNotifier host show no icon; the application then runs as a background app instead.

key.name: autostart
key.summary: Start in the background at login
key.description: Register with the XDG Background portal to launch at login and keep checking for updates.

key.name: check-interval
key.summary: How often to check for a new cycle

key.name: last-check-time
key.description: When the periodic checker last actually ran, so the schedule survives a restart. 0 means never.

key.name: last-seen-aviation-cycle
key.summary: Aviation cycle last seen by the checker
key.description: The aviation cycle label (e.g. "2608") of the last package the checker downloaded or already had, so a repeat check does not re-download the same cycle.

key.name: last-seen-obstacle-cycle
key.summary: Obstacle cycle last seen by the checker

key.name: checker-etag
key.description: The ETag (or, failing that, Last-Modified) of the provider page from the last check, sent back as If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since so an unchanged page costs the provider almost nothing.
